claims.statement: Detailed error guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES. Generic causes include unsupported plugins, cloud-conditional repository size, overridden branch-build source setting and unsupported colon filenames; these are possible diagnoses rather than verified target causes.
Fixes require another source-branch push or custom workflow trigger, subject to permissions and trigger exclusions; repair intent is not successful deployment.

Config and _data YAML syntax guidance calls for spaces, key-value spacing, UTF-8, quoting special characters and block scalars. Source simplifications are not a complete YAML grammar or parser-based validation receipt.

Online YAML linter suggestion can disclose configuration to a third party and uses an HTTP example link. No private data submitted; local diagnosis should precede any separately authorized external transfer.

Date-related Liquid filters should receive populated values, not nil/empty string. Invalid post dates require real calendar dates and documented timestamp/offset formats; filename date and front-matter timestamp are separate contexts.
Missing include diagnosis searches referenced includes and suggests moving/copying files into _includes; content provenance, licensing and safe path identity still require review.
UTF-8 remedy adds encoding setting, but non-Latin text itself is not inherently invalid; actual byte decoding must be diagnosed rather than assuming language causes failure.

Highlighter diagnosis accepts Rouge/Pygments wording; companion overview says Pygments falls back to Rouge. Invalid Sass/SCSS advice inspects error line and optionally uses linter; no linter installed or successful rendering demonstrated.

Invalid/missing submodules require intent and initialization review. Source removal sequence deinitializes, removes tracked path, commits and recursively deletes .git/modules path; destructive custody deletion was not executed or authorized.
Managed submodule guidance requires HTTPS and public repository; retain scope rather than universally banning private inputs in separately reviewed custom workflows.

Missing docs folder concerns selected branch root; remedies restore/revert, recreate source files or change publishing source. Empty folder or changed setting is not proof complete content restoration or recovery.
Relative permalinks are unsupported according to source; remove relative_permalinks and use site-root absolute paths. This does not mean externally qualified absolute URLs are always required.

Liquid for-loop syntax, closing logic tags, terminating output braces and unknown tags are separate error categories. Source conflates tag names with default variables; preserve terminology flaw and unsupported-plugin scope, not universal ban on custom local tags.

Symlink note directs Actions publishing for repositories with symbolic links; final Pages archive restrictions still apply. No commands, external code, native remediation or unlicensed file copies performed; all claims reference-only.
